info.name: Get a list of all datasets

params.name: page
params.description: Which page of results to view. Defaults to page 1.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Number of results to return on each page. Defaults to 20. Maximum allowed is 100.

params.name: publicationISSN
params.description: ISSN of a journal associated with the datasets.

params.name: publicationName
params.description: ISSN of a journal associated with the datasets.

params.name: manuscriptNumber
params.description: Manuscript number associated with the dataset.

items.docs: The items returned may depend on user permissions, and are paged.

info.name: Update the state of an in-progress dataset

params.name: doi
params.description: DOI like doi:10.1000/18238577 that should be URL encoded (example: doi%3A10.1000%2F18238577)

items.docs: Sending a JSON patch request whose JSON body looks like **[ { 'op': 'replace', 'path': '/versionStatus', 'value': 'submitted' } ]**. (This is the most common command, attempting to change the versionStatus to 'submitted'.) Other options are available that are useful for integration with manuscript processing systems. info.name: Get a download package for a dataset

params.name: doi
params.description: DOI like doi:10.1000/18238577 that should be URL encoded (example: doi%3A10.1000%2F18238577)

items.docs: This downloads the zip package of the latest submitted version of the dataset that is visible to the user (or public).

info.name: Show all versions of a dataset

params.name: doi
params.description: DOI like doi:10.1000/18238577 that should be URL encoded (example: doi%3A10.1000%2F18238577)

params.name: page
params.description: Which page of results to view. Defaults to page 1.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Number of results to return on each page. Defaults to 20. Maximum allowed is 100.

items.docs: The /versions endpoint lists all versions visible to the user (or public). This is in contrast to GETting the datasets endpoint for a DOI, since it only embeds metadata for the latest visible version.
